headline: If your baby screams every time you buckle the car seat
body:
They've worked out that the straps
mean you're farther away.
That's a smart baby,
not a broken one.

If the whole drive home is crying,
/you're still the calm one in that car./

Pulling over to settle them
isn't failing.
/It's part of the trip./

Some days, getting there
is the whole win.
